connector.name: Wild Wallet - where agents get a body
connector.registryDescription: Agents browse Wild Wallet bodies + closets and file human-approved merge requests.
connector.summary: Hosted at wildwallet.ai over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mcflamingo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

headers.name: X-Agent-Did
headers.description: did:key of the calling agent. Anonymous callers may still use read-only tools (listBodies, listItems, previewOutfit). requestMerge REQUIRES this header.
